_meta.project: instex Instrument Explorer -- INTERFEROMETER mode: Deep Synoptic Array (DSA, formerly DSA-2000)
_meta.companion: data/interf/dsa2000.md (same content as Markdown, with the full quote table).
_meta.rule: Every value carries src (key into sources), loc, and a short verbatim quote from a document saved unmodified under rawdata/interf/dsa/ (params{} holds the full records; top-level fields name their src alongside). DERIVED = arithmetic done here (shown). INFERRED = a mapping no source states. NOT FOUND = a gap. Nothing is filled from memory.
_meta.units: positions in metres: e east, n north, u up, local ENU about the array centroid (as given by ENU, 0.1 m); angles in degrees unless stated; frequencies in GHz
_meta.scope: Current design only (project baseline at the Final Design Review, 2026): 1650 x 6.155 m. The superseded 2000 x 5 m whitepaper-era design appears only in alternatives and historical_configs.

not_found: Mechanical elevation and azimuth limits of the antennas, slew rates, and whether over-the-top motion exists; the 20 deg elevation and +-2 h hour-angle limits are the sensitivity-calculator model of targeted tracks (ETC).
Datum of ENU site_height_m (1746.3 m): ellipsoidal or above sea level is not stated; no geodetic (ITRF/WGS84) antenna coordinates are published in the saved sources.
Antenna names/IDs: ENU lists positions only; names here are file-order indices (INFERRED).
An explicit statement that site_lat/lon/height in ENU is the position of the centroid origin (INFERRED from "relative to array centroid").
The method behind the CSD statement that "most baselines" lie between 4 and 6 km (figure-based; not reproduced, see conflicts).
Antenna positions of any configuration other than dsa1650_P305_v2.5.6.8 for the 1650 x 6.155 m design (the DSA2000-Cal repository keeps its antenna_config.txt files on a private server; not used).
Instantaneous bandwidth per correlator mode beyond "instantaneously covering 0.7-2 GHz" (OVW) and the ten 130.2-MHz continuum windows (ETC); exact window edges not stated.
conflicts: Dish diameter: 6.155 m (ETC Methods 1.1 and specifications table) vs 6.15 m (OVW, CSD, PTA) vs "slightly more than 6 meters" (NEWS1); 5 m in the superseded 2019-2025 design (WP, IM21, BSM). Adopted 6.155 m (the calculator's FDR baseline).
Antenna count: 1650 (ETC, ENU, OVW, CSD, NEWS1, PTA) vs 2000 (WP, BSM, POLISH; superseded) vs 2003 and 2048 rows in the whitepaper-era cfg files (WPLOC, WPW; DERIVED counts).

Footprint: ENU spans 16.4 km (E-W) x 20.1 km (N-S) DERIVED vs "20 km x 16 km" (OVW), "about 20 x 16 kilometers" (NEWS1), "10.5-by-12-mile" = 16.90 x 19.31 km (NEWS3, DERIVED). The ENU extents match OVW to 0.4% (N-S) and 2.6% (E-W).
Baselines: ENU gives Bmin 10.20 m, Bmax 20299.14 m (DERIVED) vs ETC "from 10.2 m to 20.3 km" (agree) and the specifications table "10 m to 20.3 km" (rounded).

Baseline distribution: CSD "most baselines with lengths between 4 and 6 km" vs ENU 16.4% in 4-6 km, median 7.93 km (DERIVED); the whitepaper-era cfgs give 17.5% (WPLOC) and 22.7% (WPW). The CSD text predates or differs from the FDR layout; not reproduced.
Natural-weighted beam position angle: 90.6 deg (ETC Methods 5.1 text) vs 90.34 deg (PSF natural_check); sizes agree (3.03 x 2.31 vs 3.026 x 2.310 arcsec).
Resolution: 3.0 arcsec (OVW), 3.0 x 2.3 arcsec natural at 1.35 GHz zenith (ETC) vs 3.5 arcsec (WP 2019; CSD reference-design tables) and 3.3 arcsec at 1.4 GHz (BSM, 5 m design).
Elevation limit: 20 deg in the calculator (ETC) vs 10 deg assumed for pulsar timing (PTA, which quotes dec > -41 deg; DERIVED dec > -40.45 deg at lat 39.55393).
Site: Spring Valley, Nevada (ETC, NEWS3) vs Big Smoky Valley, Nevada (POLISH 2021, earlier plan); 2019 candidate sites in California and Nevada (WP).
Status: "under construction" (PTA, 2026-09-30) vs "ready for federal environmental reviews and eventual construction" after the Final Design Review (NEWS3, 2026-09-30).
Southern HA window at dec -30 deg for el >= 20 deg: 0.566 h DERIVED vs "+-0.57 h" (ETC Methods 4.3) and "about +-0.6 hours" (ETC User guide); agree to rounding.
notes: Positions: e, n, u in metres exactly as given by ENU (local ENU about the array centroid; 0.1 m). For Earth-rotation synthesis rotate to the equatorial frame with geometry.equatorial_from_enu and lat0 = 39.55393 deg.
Primary beam: Gaussian FWHM 3.36 deg / nu_GHz (ETC) = 1.204 lambda/D for D = 6.155 m (DERIVED); 4.80 / 2.49 / 1.68 deg at 0.70 / 1.35 / 2.00 GHz.

Tracking: fully steerable az-el dishes (TECH, IM21, WP); the calculator limits targeted tracks to |HA| <= 2 h about transit and elevation >= 20 deg, and the survey uses 21-minute pointings. Unlike DSA-110 (elevation-only, meridian), DSA tracks.
Synthesized beam at zenith, 1.35 GHz: natural 3.03 x 2.31 arcsec PA 90.6 deg (ETC), uniform 2.03 x 1.57 arcsec PA 94.1 deg (PSF). lambda/Bmax = 2.26 arcsec (DERIVED).

historical_configs: the whitepaper-era cfg files (WPLOC 2003 antennas within +-7.5 km, Bmax 15000.3 m; WPW 2048 antennas, Bmax 15393.6 m; DERIVED) belong to the superseded 2000 x 5 m design and are given as statistics only.
